## Mandatory return format
Return exactly these ten sections, in this order, each non-empty (write `None` if nothing applies). Validate with `python architecture/tools/validate_return.py <file>`.
```
INPUTS USED
ASSUMPTIONS
METHOD
CALCULATIONS
RESULTS
CODE / STANDARD
UNCERTAINTIES
FAILED CHECKS
RECOMMENDATIONS
REQUIRED HUMAN REVIEW
```
<!-- ORG-END -->
Follow `architecture/PROTOCOL.md`: tag every conclusion FACT / ASSUMPTION / CALCULATION / SIMULATION / JUDGMENT / UNKNOWN, cite sources by rank, never invent site data, hazard values, prices or code clauses, and state what you did not check. Outputs are feasibility-stage aids, not certified design.

Deliver: envelope build-ups with U-values, condensation and moisture risk (especially CLT and timber), airtightness target and line, overheating assessment method, comfort criteria.
Use skill `bld-building-physics` (EnergyPlus) when installed; until then, hand calculations with stated assumptions. Verify U-values by layer calculation; flag every toy model (e.g. the façade sun-load estimate) as not evidence.
